BYD Company Limited
Notes to Financial Statements

II. BASIS OF PREPARATION OF THE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS
1. Basis of preparation
The financial statements have been prepared in accordance with the "Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises" issued by the Ministry of Finance and the specific accounting standards, interpretations and other relevant regulations issued and revised thereafter (collectively known as the "ASBE").

3. Reporting currency
The Company's reporting currency and the currency used in preparing the financial statements were Renminbi. The amounts in the financial statements were denominated in thousands of Renminbi, unless otherwise stated.
